approvers: Owner/director, the client or developer, and the glazing subcontractor
reason: ACHV is a contractor too and I don't want a competitor on my site or seeing my programme, whatever confidentiality paper they sign. We spend under a thousand a year on this, so it is not worth the supplier paperwork and the risk for me.
objection: A competing contractor on my site with access to my programme, and no Maltese reference job to show it works on our glass and frames.
instead: Keep using the peelable coating we have now, or plain protection film and tape, and let the glazing subcontractor handle their own protection.
would_change_my_mind: A finished Maltese job I can visit, written compatibility confirmation from the coating maker for our glass, and a pure supply option with no ACHV staff on site.
